summary.zh: 写或审 Asio 网络代码时避开异步陷阱
summary.en: Write and review Asio networking code without async bugs.

description.zh: 面向使用 Boost.Asio 或独立版 Asio 的 C++ 网络代码，覆盖 TCP、UDP、SSL、定时器、strand、协程与完成回调。在动手写或审查之前套用对象生命周期、执行器绑定和取消规则，绕开常见的异步问题。
description.en: Covers C++ networking with Boost.Asio or standalone Asio: TCP, UDP, SSL, timers, strands, coroutines and handlers. Use it before writing or reviewing such code; its lifetime, affinity and cancellation rules avoid the usual async bugs.
